edhrecPage.intro: For each of EDHREC's real top 100 Commander picks (by its own popularity ranking), a decklist is synthesized from that commander's real average deck composition and most-played cards — not a decklist any single person built.
edhrecPage.disclaimer: These decks are computed, not real — EDHREC has no hosted decklists to browse, only card-recommendation statistics per commander. Each one picks the most-played cards per category up to that commander's typical real card-type counts (e.g. "24 creatures, 35 lands"). Treat it as a reasonable starting point, not a deck anyone actually plays as-is.
edhrecPage.syncing: Syncing… (can take a minute — up to 100 real page fetches)
edhrecPage.empty: No synthesized decks cached yet — click "Sync now" above.

preconsPage.intro: Real official Commander preconstructed decks (from MTGJSON's own bulk deck data, exact card-for-card lists) ranked by how much of each one you'd already own — the actual answer to "which deck could I build right now with the fewest purchases", computed fresh against your collection every time you open this page.
preconsPage.syncing: Syncing… (can take a couple minutes — ~190 real deck fetches)

discoverCubesPage.intro: Real popular cubes from CubeCobra's own public rankings (by likes) — browse, then import one with a click instead of hunting for a URL yourself. Cached locally; hit "Sync now" to refresh the list.
